notes.title: Windows Bug fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi Players![/p][p][/p][p]I have done some fixing on the windows version. There was a bug which should not have been present. you were not able to load into the Lake House. It is now open to the Windows Users and should not cause any problems anymore.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]
